A person or an agent left a space, or was removed from it.

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** a person  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`membership.removed.json`](/schema/membership.removed.json)

Written by Chips; absent, a person took them out or they left the room. One of `archived`, `deleted`, `moved`, `agent_archived`, `removed`, `agent_deleted`, `person_removed`, `person_left`. |
